description: This PHP class 'SqlmapOutputProcessor' is responsible for processing the output of sqlmap scans. It reads the log file from a given path, searches for indications of SQL injection points, extracts parameter information, and records vulnerabilities accordingly.

classes.name: SqlmapOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractOutputProcessor to parse sqlmap output logs and detect SQL injection vulnerabilities.

methods.name: getCommandUsageExample
methods.description: Provides an example command line usage for sqlmap with a typical URL.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads the log file at the given path, detects SQL injection points, and records vulnerabilities.
